pages.text: RFTools Dimensions builds dimensions to your own design out of Dimlets. The pack's design puts Oblivion's Rift, a procedural endgame dungeon, on top of it. The Rift is not in the game yet.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() every Rift run was to be a dimension of its own, opened with a $(bold)Rift Keystone$(). Neither is built, and the keystone has no recipe until the Rift exists. What you can build today is RFTools Dimensions itself.

$(bold)No book needed.$() RFTools Dimensions is documented in JEI and on the $(bold)RFTools wiki$(). The core loop is the Dimension Builder and the Dimlet system: craft Dimlets to set a dimension's properties, insert them into a Dimension Tab and power the builder.$(br2)$(bold)Next: bank Rift Shards$() ($(l:icraft:loot/rift_economy)Rift Shard Economy$(/l)).
